global_assertions: every frame uses id: sequence, event: event_type, and single-line JSON data
sequence begins at 1 for a Run and is strictly increasing without duplicates
exactly one terminal event occurs: done or error
no event occurs after a terminal event
a normal tool_start has one later tool_end with the same tool_call_id

cases.name: normal completion
assertions: final message citations equal citation event set

cases.name: review withholding
assertions: review_required reason_codes nonempty and confidence in [0,1]

cases.name: replay
sequence: only sequence greater than supplied ID
assertions: replay creates no run or event ID
first replayed TCP frame need not be meta
